name: ggajos-tasks-eye
description: Find your next action across your notes. Focus on today, plan ahead, and keep your task workflow in order.

scripts.build: biome check --write . && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && eslint src --max-warnings=0 && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.dev:docs: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && node acceptance/scripts/publish-doc-screenshots.mjs && tsx scripts/build-docs.ts && astro build --config docs-src/astro.config.mjs
scripts.dev:docs:serve: npm run dev:docs && astro preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --config docs-src/astro.config.mjs

longDescription:
Attention is precious. Tasks Eye is a free, open source plugin built around a simple goal: help you tackle today’s commitments, decide what deserves attention next, and reach a clear stopping point for the day.

Your notes are the units of work, with each next action kept close to the ideas, decisions, and context behind it. A task’s date says when it should return to your attention; its priority helps you choose what comes first. Work can move forward a little at a time, with a deliberate decision about when to return to what remains.

Focus gives today’s commitments a clear place. Open makes room for thoughtful planning, while Inbox helps keep the underlying system trustworthy. The aim is a manageable day and a considered tomorrow. Today’s queue can be clear while future work remains open, leaving you free to stop or work ahead when it is useful.

Built on your Markdown notes and the community Tasks plugin, Tasks Eye keeps the work in your vault. It is shared freely with the community under the MIT license.
